profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: I am a software professional with over 30 years of experience.  The record shows that I have participated in software research and development projects in many roles:  Director, team leader, and developer.  Moreover, I have worked on many different types of software projects:  Research (academic and non-academic),  and Development.  I have demonstrated the versatility to lead and to follow, to publish original research, and to work in many different fields (from AI to Market Data).  At heart, I am a problem solver; a mathematician in a software developer's body.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Worked as a software engineer supporting Tricare West.  This work mostly involved Java and Javascript.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: I worked as a software engineer to support Tomahawk (cruise missile) Mission Planning (TMP).  I also worked as a software engineer to support F15 Mission Planning (F15MP).  Mission Planning is a ground-based, graphic intensive Geographic Information System used to develop routes and weapons planning for mission execution.   In this work I used Visual Basic (.NET), Ada, FORTRAN, Subversion, and a variety of desktop development tools/utilities to develop the system in a classified development/test/delivery environment.  This work required me to be an instrumental part of the development team, including executing tests to ensure proper functioning of the software.  These tests served the function of assessing the acceptability of the final products to the customer.  This position required a SECRET security clearance.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: I worked as a software developer on a web-based system to assist controllers at the Air Mobility Command (AMC) at Scott AFB, Illinois.  AMC has a global air operations center responsible for planning and executing not only air refueling missions but also airlift missions for moving cargo and passengers on a global basis. This project involved many software applications to support the planning and execution of these missions.  I worked primarily on the Mission Setup Sheet application, responsible for organizing and planning entire air missions.

positions.title: Independent Consultant
positions.description:
I worked as a Knowledge Representation/Reasoning and Algorithm Complexity consultant.  In this role, I did the following:
     •	I revisited the development and maintenance of a complex knowledge representation scheme I developed earlier with Knowledge Based Systems, Inc.
     •	I contributed to research in a data model integration project.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
I researched and developed a variety of software applications that translate data from various trading exchanges to an internal format to be stored in proprietary servers for later retrieval and analysis.  This included:
•	Supporting the development of the Hermes server product for storing and retrieving real-time trade data.
•	Researching and developing replacement strategies for the firm’s cache servers for high-performance trade data retrieval.
•	Developing and maintaining internal feed handler applications, which take real-time trade data from various data feeds (NASDAQ NTDS/UQDF/UTDF, OPRA, CME), in varying formats, and translating them into Townsend’s proprietary format for processing by the TA_SRV product.  These feed handlers are written in C/C++ on Windows.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
I supported the software team by:
•	Developing key components for several Web-based products.
•	Employing Geneer’s “Code Science” development methodology, a derivative of “Xtreme Programming”.
•	Utilizing advanced technologies such as COM+ and XML/XSL, as well as JavaScript, VBScript, and SQLServer to deliver solutions.  I also participated in the development of a software tool for configuring Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs).

positions.title: Director of Software Engineering/Senior Project Manager
positions.description:
I directed and supported the product development activities of a small software firm specializing in process and data modeling software for Business Process Reengineering activities.  In this role:
•	I provided technical and managerial direction for over 10 software products.
•	I supervised and supported the RAPTR (Readiness Assessment and Planning Tool for Reengineering) project.  I operated as a key partner for this project, which produced software that assesses an enterprise’s readiness for change, and produces a change-management project plan tailored to address any issues that threaten the success of the change effort.

positions.title: Senior Technology Specialist
positions.description:
I supervised and supported software teams across multiple specialties at a firm specializing in IT services and integrated justice information systems.
•	I oversaw the Client/Server and Research and Development divisions.
•	I managed and participated in projects to create graphical user interfaces (GUI) to legacy mainframe and workstation applications.
•	I orchestrated the development of knowledge-based subsystems to production software.

positions.title: Senior Knowledge Engineer
positions.description:
I integrated knowledge-based systems into new software and supervised research projects while pursuing my doctorate degree.  This included:
•	Creating software for organizing and monitoring the knowledge assets associated with a typical manufacturing design process.
•	Directing a research project to develop a theoretical foundation for integrating information models. and to use this foundation to construct tools for supporting information model integration.

positions.title: Knowledge Engineer
positions.description:
I worked full time in a research lab while pursuing my masters degree. My research focused on aspects of knowledge based system development and artificial intelligence.
•	I directed a research project to design and develop an environment for reasoning using production rules and facts.
•	I developed an intelligent system for determining whether or not the design of a given part is machinable and, if so, to determine the most cost-effective plan for machining that part.
•	I helped develop an automated control system for a small, unmanned submarine.

company.name: TEXAS A&M KNOWLEDGE BASED SYSTEMS LABORATORY
